editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the TRUE Zero Waste Advisor Certification exam administered by Green Business Certification Inc. Review all domains, duration, and passing score.
editorial.overview: The TRUE Zero Waste Advisor Certification exam, administered by Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI), comprehensively covers fundamental zero waste principles, facility operations, diversion metrics, and detailed reporting requirements. It evaluates advisors on implementing sustainable materials management practices across modern facilities to ensure strong sustainability performance, waste reduction, and effective environmental stewardship.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals and facility managers seeking to guide organizations toward zero waste goals, reduce carbon footprints, and implement sustainable materials management practices should take this certification.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review the TRUE rating system requirements and understand waste diversion calculations completely before your scheduled test date. Focus heavily on the core practices of reduction, reuse, composting, and recycling alongside reporting policies to ensure complete readiness and success on the examination.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers fundamentals of zero waste and facility operations, focusing extensively on materials management hierarchies and waste reduction strategies to establish basic knowledge for candidates taking the test and working professionally.

Details the TRUE certification framework and the specific responsibilities of a TRUE advisor within facility projects, outlining how professionals manage and execute sustainability initiatives successfully across various commercial properties.

Explores upstream strategies including product redesign, reduction practices, and material reuse methods designed to minimize overall waste generation before materials ever enter the facility stream during daily commercial operations.

Focuses on container sizing and service levels to optimize collection and handling of materials, ensuring that facilities maintain efficient streams and proper capacities for all waste produced daily.

Addresses organic re-earth processes like composting and standard material recycling activities, teaching candidates how to properly process organic waste and recyclable goods to achieve high diversion rates successfully.

Details reporting metrics and diversion calculations relative to landfills, incineration, and the environment, ensuring candidates understand how to accurately measure and report diversion performance for their organizations and facility projects.

Examines performance metrics used to evaluate and track zero waste progress across various projects, providing professionals with the analytical tools needed to monitor long-term sustainability goals effectively over time.

Explores purchasing practices, leadership involvement, employee training, and zero waste analysis, emphasizing the organizational structures necessary to sustain ongoing waste management programs over extended operational periods within modern business facilities.

Covers methodologies for conducting waste audits to assess material streams and generation points accurately, helping advisors identify specific opportunities for improvement within commercial and industrial facilities during projects.

Focuses on upstream management, hazardous waste prevention, closed-loop systems, and innovation, preparing advisors to tackle complex modern challenges in sustainable materials management and circular economies within diverse facilities.
study_focus: Hazardous waste prevention and closed loop

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully across the 75 questions during the 90-minute appointment. Ensure you meet the 77% passing score by thoroughly reviewing each scenario presented on test day.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The TRUE Zero Waste Advisor Certification exam consists of a total of 75 questions covering various important domains of zero waste and professional facility management principles.
To successfully pass the official examination and earn the recognized TRUE Advisor credential, candidates must achieve a minimum passing score of 77% on test day.
Candidates are given a total allotted duration of exactly 90 minutes to complete all questions included on the official examination appointment at the testing center.

faq.question_title: Who administers the TRUE Zero Waste Advisor exam?
faq.answer_text: The TRUE Zero Waste Advisor Certification exam is administered directly by Green Business Certification Inc., which manages professional credentials under established global sustainability and environmental frameworks for advisors worldwide.
